summary: Require abort-aware host APIs to inspect current signal state before registering cancellation work.

target.notes: Reuse the existing DOM EventTarget subsystem for listener registration/dispatch; this rule owns AbortSignal-specific state and abort algorithms.

semantics.preaborted: consumer observes existing reason immediately under its own contract

caveats: Fetch-specific rejection timing remains WEB_URL_FETCH ownership.
references: WHATWG DOM Living Standard § AbortController / AbortSignal
